paragraphs: Ben Bunyayim, very wealthy, sent Rabbi four fine linen garments, Hannizakin 59a: a large cloak that measured only a walnut and a half when folded. Keitzad Mishtattefin 83a: Bunyom sent Rabbi a modia kandisa [Rashi: a kind of se’ah measure].
